T.topic_fa: نام روی ساختمان، نام روی پرده: هر نامی برای یک مخاطب است
T.topic_en: The name on the building vs the name on the screen: every name has one audience
T.central_tension_fa: دو نام افسانه‌ای سینما یکی شدند و نام شرکت تازه هیچ‌کدامشان نیست. ما فکر می‌کنیم نام شرکت مادر باید ستاره باشد؛ ولی هیچ‌کس از «شرکت» بلیت نمی‌خرد. نام بالای سر برای بانک و سهام‌دار است؛ نامی که مشتری می‌شناسد را دست نزن.
T.central_tension_en: Two of the most famous names in film merged, and the new company is named after neither. We think the parent name should be the star. But nobody buys a ticket from a holding company. The name on top is for investors; the name people love is the one you don't touch.
T.working_hook_fa: دو اسم افسانه‌ای یکی شدند. اسم تازه، هیچ‌کدامشان نیست.
T.working_hook_en: Two legendary studios merged. The new name is neither of them.

key_sources.claim: Combined Paramount + Warner Bros Discovery to be named Skydance; Ellison: 'We never wanted a new corporate identity to diminish, alter or overshadow either one'; legal name Skydance Corporation from Oct 6; Emarketer analyst Ross Benes called it 'ego-driven'.
Name comes from Ellison's former production company; studios, HBO, DC, CNN keep their identities (compared to Pixar and Marvel inside Disney); online reaction largely negative (anecdotal).

Skydance launched Oct 6; the existing Skydance logo animation (Imaginary Forces) shows letters converging in a star field, based on a mechanical solar-system model; Skydance sits above Paramount and Warner Bros as the connecting corporate name.

T.framing_note: News is the spark; the reel is about who each name serves (corporate/endorsing name vs product brand) and the founder's urge to put their own name on top. Do not say the name failed or that customers rejected it (reaction is anecdotal; one analyst quote). Keep it non-political: no monopoly, newsroom or CNN/CBS editorial angle. No studio or publication names in on-screen headline lines if avoidable; brand names fine in body/caption. Never use real people's faces. Never name the UAE, Dubai or any emirate. Takeaway for owners: before renaming, list which audience each name speaks to (customers, staff, investors, banks) and protect the one customers already search for.
